source: ICRA'13 Fig. 4(a)/Fig. 5 (identical figures: STAR'13 Fig. 3(a)/(c), TOR'16 Fig. 4(a)/Fig. 5)
description: Six-vertex tree used to illustrate the time-expanded network. Vertex names follow the figure labels; 'a' and 'b' are the two unlabeled spine vertices (a adjacent to s1-, s2-; b adjacent to s1+, s2+). Robot i: s_i^+ -> s_i^-.

network_T2.formula: nodes=(2T+1)|V|+2|E|T, arcs=T|V| green + T|V| blue + 5|E|T gadget + n loopbacks

note_T2_infeasible: The figure's T=2 network admits no full flow (value 0): it is illustrative only.

eq7_objective_with_green_cost_1_at_T4.comment: With the paper's c2 (green holdover arcs cost 1) the 'distance' objective (ICRA eq. 7, TOR eq. 12/16) is constant n*T over every feasible flow.

eq7_objective_with_green_cost_0_at_T4.comment: = sum of shortest path lengths; STAR Sec. 5.1 sets holdover cost to 0, and the Java Distance solver only costs curV != nextV arcs.

figure_inconsistency: In ICRA/TOR Fig. 5 the loopback e2 (and in TOR the bold blue goal arcs) start at the spine row 'a' at 2', while the s2^- label (and Fig. 4(a)) put s2^- on the offset leaf row; STAR Fig. 3(c) (no loopbacks) labels consistently.
